link_coverage.exhausted_reason: Two independent, differently-typed censuses resolve to exactly one qualifying public issuer, and it qualifies only through a wholly-owned subsidiary. The SEC's own company index returns no company record for EW Group, Hendrix Genetics, Grimaud, Hubbard or Lohmann; Aviagen appears solely through a 2003 Regulation D private-placement notice; Cobb-Vantress appears only as a co-registrant on its parent's shelf. Credible industry press independently enumerates the same population as two corporations for all layer and turkey stock and most broiler stock. Below the ten-issuer target and closed honestly at one rather than left OPEN.

combined_search_scope.qualification_boundary: Public legal issuers that own or control primary poultry breeding stock, meaning great-grandparent or grandparent layer, broiler or turkey genetics sold as breeding birds or hatching eggs to commercial producers. Excludes commercial producers who BUY that stock, and excludes hatcheries that multiply parent stock they do not own the genetics of.
combined_search_scope.coverage_statement: SEC EDGAR's company-name index was queried for all six named primary-breeder brands and for the two groups that own them, and SEC EDGAR full-text search was run over every US public filer's 10-K for the trailing year. Independently, the USDA-derived poultry industry manual enumerates the entire primary broiler breeding population as three companies. Both planes resolve to the same answer: one qualifying public issuer, reached only through a subsidiary.

notes.text: The census changed the answer and that is the point of running it. Before it, the chain and the impact appraisal both said the poultry-genetics link had no listed exposure at all. The registry search found Cobb-Vantress in the SEC index, and the full-text search found it named in Tyson's own EX-21. So the honest statement is not 'no listed exposure' but 'exactly one listed route, reached through a wholly-owned subsidiary inside a meat processor'. That is a weaker claim and a truer one, and the chain's map_limitation and the appraisal's public_reach rationale should be read against it.

Control probe, run on the same plane and the same query shape as every target search: cal-maine returns CAL-MAINE FOODS INC, CIK 0000016160, SIC 0200 AGRICULTURE PRODUCTION, and charles river returns its filer record. Both are poultry-or-avian-adjacent names of the same specificity as the targets. Non-zero hits on the controls beside zero hits on the targets is what separates a genuine absence from a broken query.
Author run. Status stays ACTIVE and the author does not mark this mapping COMPLETE; that is the fresh-context audit's call, not this seat's.
